what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Mauritania in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17825 Mauritanian asylum seekers in the United States, 62.7% of all asylum seekers from Mauritania.
Refugees from Mauritania, a separate group, live mostly in Senegal, Mali and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mauritania with AQIM in 2010 only.
The fact pack does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew in recent years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1207 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 18798, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
